messages:
Asha: Morning — quick handoff. I'm primary until 12:00 PDT; I'll be out for a short drive 09:35–10:20 and will have my phone but might be slow to respond. There's an active P2 (INC-482) for embeddings high p95 latency since ~03:20 UTC. Incident summary and runbook below from incident-bot. Need someone to take immediate pages during my travel window and be ready to execute a hotpatch/rollback if latency spikes after the canary revert. Ping @Ravi or @Marta if you can cover. :wave

incident-bot: INC-482 created · severity: P2 · service: inference-api/embeddings · started: 1769988000 · impact: elevated p95 token latency for embeddings; errors not observed but throughput degraded for some customers. Current mitigation: investigation in progress, metrics in grafana: /d/embeddings/latency; runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/INC-482-embeddings-latency — follow the "canary-revert" section if latency increases after 10:30 PDT. Paging policy: page primary, if no ack in 2m page secondary; if no ack in 5m escalate to offcall.

Ravi: I can cover 09:40–10:20 PT. I'll ack pages during that window and follow the runbook actions. Suggest we set the secondary to me for that interval. Also will monitor `redwoodctl metrics tail --service=inference-api --query=p95` and keep a short log.

Dan: Thanks Ravi — confirm. If you get a page, try the quick checks first: 1) check canary pod CPU/memory 2) check KV cache hit rate 3) confirm network egress to model-hosts. Commands I use: ```kubectl get pods -l app=inference-api -o wide
kubectl top pod inference-api-canary-3
redwoodctl cache stats --service inference-api
``` If you need to rollback the canary: ```redwoodctl rollout rollback --service inference-api --to revision=canary-prev --reason "canary-latency-regression"``` Also, temporarily disable the autoscale hook if it's causing flapping: ```kubectl annotate hpa inference-api redwood.io/auto-scale=false --overwrite``` Runbook section: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/INC-482-embeddings-latency#canary-revert

Marta: I'll stage the hotpatch script and provide sudo to the oncall covering the revert. File path: `/opt/runbooks/hotpatches/canary-revert.sh`. It contains the safe-rollback with healthchecks and post-verify. If anyone needs it early DM me and I'll transfer keys. I'll also pre-create the rollback change in deploy tool so it's a 1-command revert.

Asha: Quick note on customer comms — current impact is latency, degrade visible but not failing. If this goes beyond 30 minutes or error rate >0.5% we notify CS and EngProd. Use this snippet for customer impact callouts: "Investigating higher-than-normal latency for embeddings; we're reverting a recent canary to restore performance. No data loss expected."

Leo: I can be on standby starting 11:20 PT and take over secondary duty after 11:30 if needed. If Asha doesn't respond within the travel window -> Ravi is primary by agreement. Can we also temporarily route pages to both primary+secondary for the 09:40–10:20 window? That reduces missed pages. :+1:

deploy-bot: Planned action: schedule hotpatch `canary-revert.sh` at 10:40 PT on cluster infra-canary-3. If the step fails automated rollback flag is enabled. Link to change: https://redwood.internal/deploys/changes/CHG-9012

Asha: Confirming plan: Ravi primary 09:40–10:20, Leo standby after 11:20, Marta has hotpatch ready, Dan will own rollback commands if escalation needed. I'm leaving the runbook quick commands here for Ravi to copy: ```# tail metrics
redwoodctl metrics tail --service=inference-api --query=p95 --window=5m
# small healthcheck
curl -sS https://inference-api-canary-3.health/readiness | jq .status
# rollback
redwoodctl rollout rollback --service inference-api --to revision=canary-prev
``` Please add any extra notes in this thread. Thanks all — I'll check in once I'm back. :pray:
